matches.why: Nothing trending today edits short-form video for social media.
It's built specifically to capture, compress, and re-inject project context across sessions so a coding assistant stops forgetting the project.
It enforces spec-first planning, red/green TDD, YAGNI and DRY to stop agents from shipping bloated, over-engineered code.
Nothing today organizes or indexes personal research PDFs/articles.
No footage-free news-visualization tool trended today.
Nothing today is a bioinformatics tool for a small lab.

Today's local-first agent tools (OpenMausBot, openbot, OpenBot) still route conversations through cloud model providers (Claude/Codex/Grok APIs), so none is a genuinely private law-firm chat solution.
Nothing today is a self-hosted personal notes app; DeepTutor is a tutoring product, not a notes replacement.
Its living SPEC.md graph documents how a codebase fits together as the agent reads and maintains it, giving a new hire durable project knowledge.
It's a complete start-to-finish methodology (spec, plan, build, test) for building software with AI agents, a reasonable on-ramp for a first AI product.
